panels.description: Bua-ji sits behind ledgers and mustard sacks while Guddu stands opposite with his permit folder. Leave upper-left desk space.
A loan ledger lies beside Saand’s unsigned bid papers awaiting approval. Keep the upper third clear.
Guddu leans over a rough GODARAZ plan and points at four lanes. Keep the upper-left plan margin clear.
Bua-ji closes the ledger. An open cash box behind it visibly contains a folded GODARAZ flyer. Keep upper-left space open.

items.speaker: BUA-JI
items.text: The warehouse is collateral. Miss the opening, it goes to Saand.

items.speaker: GUDDU
items.text: First we open, then we become stable. This is the normal sequence.

items.speaker: GUDDU
items.text: Four lanes. Imported pine. International standard, saab.
